raw_segments.text: If there existed in America a class of citizens whom the legislating majority sought to deprive
of exclusive privileges which they had possessed for ages, and to bring down from an elevated
station to the level of the ranks of the multitude, it is probable that the minority would be
less ready to comply with its laws.
